verdict.rationale: BILL S&E documents setting up budgets alongside users and virtual cards, with a recipe tying users, budgets and cards together, and marketing says every transaction is "controlled" and "automatically compliant." The evidence does not explicitly show allocation to teams or projects, card limits that enforce budget caps, or spend approvals; the documented approval policies cover AP bills, a different workflow. Missing for 10: explicit team/project budget allocation, documented card-limit enforcement against budgets, spend-side approval workflows tied to budgets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them
